x: N Gunn, of Mitcham A C., ran his usual good race in this event. In the 1200 yards relay, in which we were placed third at the previous meeting, a really brilliant 300 yards by our stylish youngster, A J.
The Mile Team Race, which we have always won in recent years, gave us another victory Bill Webb was first man home, followed by Norman Gunn, of Mitcham A.C.
Joe Flower, up against Norman Gunn, held his own but that was all, and so when Tom Scrimshaw went off for the final half he was about 40 yds. down on Ferdinando of Mitcham.

Bill Rice forced the pace throughout, with Norman Gunn his closest attendant until near home, when Joe went by the latter. Thus matters ended all square on the evening, Belgrave, Croydon and Mitcham each scoring 12 points with Epsom 4.

Joe Flower went next and Ayton, of Mitcham, cut into this lead, so that when Martin went off he had about 10 yards lead over Norman Gunn. It was here that experience told and although Martin ran a very plucky race, Gunn reduced his lead to a bare yard or so.
